body.p: The Search view's Keys tab allows you to see all DITA keys defined in the context publication. You can insert key references or open the key definition location.

dlentry.dd: Filter keys by searching based on their name or contents.

Keys defined in the list can either have keyword content or can refer to resources (topics, images, web links). Depending on the key type, when hovering each key card you can insert various kinds of key references:
Key with keyword: Insert as phrase reference.
Key with reference to a DITA XML topic: Insert link or related link.
Key with reference to an image: Insert image reference or figure with image reference.
Key with reference to audio/video files: Insert embedded audio or video resources.
Key with reference to a web link: Insert link or related link.
